literal_gloss: Read-by-me minutes of-the first council in three volumes; of-Gelasius bore the book inscription, as rather being minutes than history. Paltry and humble in expression, except in-detail goes-through the in the council.
source_text: Codex 15 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, pp. 4; closeout-4b transcription)
